reason: User excludes font/spacing differences; v1 retained wrappers/spacing arguments and used texts array rather than formal tree order. Unicode NFKC in code could hide literal character change.
font_policy: Brace-aware wrapper removal, argument preserved; no unknown macro expansion.
spacing_policy: hspace/vspace and dimension arguments removed; math operators/indices/numerals/units retained.
currency_policy: Escaped currency and bare unpaired dollar remain significant; only paired outer math delimiters stripped.
code_policy: No Unicode normalization, code literal Unicode remains significant; whitespace/indentation separately diagnosed.
order_policy: DFS body children, pictures, caption/footnote refs deduplicated. Unlinked nonfurniture items stable appended with unknown tree position. Fixed E0 refs never rematched.
source_unit_limit: 387 formula outer-block units, not independent-equation count; row-inventory.json derives lexical segments without changing sealed units.
